content.title: 24 Restaurant Chains Open on Easter Sunday
content.text: Easter Sunday might be a time for church, egg hunts, and awkward family photos, but it doesn’t mean the whole country shuts down. While some restaurant chains close up to give their staff a well-earned break, plenty of spots will stay open. So in case you’re skipping the ham this year, here are the restaurant chains that are open on Easter Sunday, April 5, 2026, plus the ones that are closed. Applebee’sBrett_Hondow/istockphotoMost Applebee’s locations will be open on Easter Sunday. Hours can vary, though, since the chain is franchise-operated, so it’s best to check with your local restaurant.Buffalo Wild WingsSweetBabeeJay/istockphotoThose craving wings after the egg hunt are in luck, as the chain plans to stay open on Easter, with most locations following regular Sunday hours. Still, a quick call ahead is recommended.Benihana©TripAdvisorBenihana is typically open on Easter Sunday if you’re planning a hibachi-style meal, but hours can vary by location, so it’s best to check with your local restaurant before making plans.Burger KingJonathan Weiss / shutterstockYou can have it your way on Easter Sunday. Most Burger King locations are open, though some may shorten hours, so it’s smart to check locally.Cheesecake FactoryChristian Petersen/Getty ImagesYes, they’re open — and yes, you can still end your Easter with a slab of Oreo Dream Extreme. Just keep in mind that some locations might tweak hours or limit reservations.Chili’ssanfel/istockphotoChili’s Grill & Bar is expected to be open on Easter Sunday if you’re craving a sit-down meal, but hours can vary by location, so it’s best to check with your nearest restaurant before heading out.Denny’ssanfel/istockphotoDenny’s will remain open 24/7 as usual, with no changes for the holiday.Domino’s PizzaRiverNorthPhotography/istockphotoMost locations will be open for delivery and carryout on Easter, but hours can vary — check your local store before placing that order.Cracker Barrelsanfel/istockphotoCracker Barrel will be open from 7 a.m. to 9 p.m. on Easter Sunday, serving the usual comfort food for dine-in, takeout, or delivery.Dunkin’Tim Gray/istockphotoMany Dunkin’ locations will be open, though some may reduce hours for the holiday. It’s a good idea to confirm with your local shop.Golden Corraljetcityimage/istockphotoGolden Corral will be open on Easter Sunday, following their standard hours at most locations.IHOPWolterk/istockphotoIHOP will stay open nationwide, operating with either 24/7 or regular Sunday hours, depending on the branch.Jimmy John’sMay A. / YelpJimmy John’s will be open on Easter Sunday, so you can still grab a sandwich — but it’s a good idea to check with your local store to confirm hours.KFCtupungato/istockphotoKFC will likely be open on Easter Sunday for your fried chicken fix, but since hours can vary, it’s best to check with your local restaurant before you go.McDonald’sjetcityimage/istockphotoMost McDonald’s restaurants will be open on Easter, but hours vary widely depending on the location.Olive GardenBrett_Hondow/istockphotoOlive Garden will be open on Easter Sunday, following their usual Sunday hours. The chain typically only closes on Thanksgiving and Christmas.Red Lobsterjetcityimage/istockphotoRed Lobster plans to open most locations for Easter, though some may limit service to takeout and delivery only.Sonic Drive-InWolterk/istockphotoSonic will be open and operating under normal Sunday hours, with drive-in and carhop service as usual.Starbucksjetcityimage/istockphotoStarbucks locations will be open, but many will have reduced or adjusted hours. Checking the store locator is recommended.SubwayTennesseePhotographer / istockphotoMost Subway restaurants will be open on Easter, though hours depend on the individual franchise. Calling ahead is best.Taco BellJonathan Weiss / shutterstockTaco Bell is expected to open most locations with regular Sunday hours, but there may be some local variations.Texas Roadhousejetcityimage/istockphotoTexas Roadhouse will be open on Easter Sunday, though hours can vary depending on the location.Waffle Housejetcityimage/istockphotoWaffle House remains open 24/7 every day of the year, including Easter Sunday.Wendy’sjetcityimage/istockphotoMost Wendy’s locations will be open on Easter, but store hours can differ. A quick local check is a good idea.Closed on Easter Sunday 2026CBS Mornings / YelpCava — Cava will be closed at all locations for Easter, treating it as a major holiday.Chick-fil-A — Chick-fil-A is always closed on Sundays, and Easter is no exception.Chipotle — All Chipotle locations will be closed on Easter Sunday as part of their standard holiday schedule.Firehouse Subs — Firehouse Subs will be closed for Easter to give employees the day off.Panera Bread — Most, if not all, Panera Bread cafés will be closed on Easter Sunday. A few franchise locations might open, but it’s not common.Raising Cane’s — Raising Cane’s will be closed at all locations in observance of the holiday.More From CheapismErin Kuschner / Cheapism
